run_structure_generator_cli: run the structure generator CLI to create adsorbate slab placements with vasp input files
run_precompute_slabs: run the precompute slabs function to generate and save slab surfaces for bulk indices
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to validate and return command line arguments for structure generation
run_run_placements: run the run_placements function to generate adsorbate placements for a single bulk surface adsorbate combination
review_StructureGenerator_class: review the StructureGenerator class that creates adsorbate bulk slab objects and writes vasp input files
